subject: AstraLith security onboarding: scheduling intake call & artifact runbook
messages:
From: Evan Price <evan.price@astralith.com>
To: jasmine_liu@redwood.com
Cc: Priya Shah <priya.shah@astralith.com>
Date: Tue, 21 Sep 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Quick intro + intake call for security questionnaire

Hi Jasmine,

Thanks for taking this on. We're aiming to get a CAIQ/SIG intake scheduled this week — the procurement team has asked for a short runbook as well so they can scope the internal reviewers. High-level asks:

- 30–45 minute intake call to walk questionnaire scope (CAIQ + a short SIG supplement)
- What evidence/artifacts you'll need up-front for an efficient handoff (logs, architecture diagram, encryption attestations, SOC 2 snapshot)
- A single shared drop location and expected delivery timelines (we typically do 2-week sprints for artifact collection)

Our team (me and Priya) are available Thu 9/23 9–11am PT or Fri 9/24 1–4pm PT. Do either work for you?

I've attached our current SIG export (v0.9) to give you a head start — it's the working copy our info-sec team uses.

Appreciate it,
Evan
Evan Price | Head of InfoSec
AstraLith

Hi Evan — great to meet you over email. Thu 9/23 9–9:45am PT works for our team; I booked a 45-minute slot to leave room for Q&A. Ben (account lead) and Marissa (security intake owner) are on the thread so we can cover both procurement/context and the SIG/CAIQ technical asks.

Pre-call plan:
- 10 min: scope confirmation (CAIQ v3 + SIG supplement areas: data residency, key management, logging)
- 20 min: artifact checklist & evidence owners (we'll ask which team at AstraLith owns each item)
- 15 min: next steps & delivery runbook (shared folder, naming conventions, expected ETA)

Can you confirm the attendee list for the call and whether you want us to record? We will share a single Google Drive folder and a short runbook template ahead of the call.

Link (placeholder) for calendar invite: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=astrolith-intake-20260923

A couple of pre-call notes so we can be efficient:
1) We uploaded the SIG export as a starting point (attached) — you'll see a bunch of TBDs under logging and key rotation.

Date: Thu, 23 Sep 2026 12:15:00 -0700
Subject: Notes: AstraLith intake call — 9/23/2026 (recording + actions)

Hi all — quick follow-up from our call earlier (recording saved in the shared folder). Key notes and owners below.

Summary:
- Confirmed scope: CAIQ v3 baseline + SIG supplement focusing on logging, KMS, and data residency.
- Redwood will provide a runbook template and an artifacts checklist by EOD 9/24.

Action items (owners & ETA):
1) Redwood: Deliver runbook template + artifact checklist (jasmine_liu) — due 2026-09-24 EOD. Link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1AstraLith-Redwood-Onboarding (folder created)
2) AstraLith: Drop SOC 2 redacted report and a 7-day log sample (evan.price) — prefer S3 presigned link; ETA 2026-09-29
3) AstraLith: Populate SIG spreadsheet with ownership for TBD rows (priya.shah) — ETA 2026-09-28
4) Redwood: Annotated SOC 2 summary (redwood_security) — delivered as Redwood_SOC2_Summary_Q1_2026.pdf (uploaded)
5) Redwood procurement: Start contract paperwork conversation (ben_carter) — Ben will send procurement checklist 2026-09-24

Notes & clarifications:
- Log sample format: we requested JSONL with column mapping (timestamp, request_id, endpoint, status_code) and a short README describing filters applied.
- Data residency: AstraLith clarified EU customers are routed to eu-1; we flagged the need to capture region-specific routing in the CAIQ answers.
- KMS: AstraLith uses Azure Key Vault; Marissa requested a brief architecture diagram and key rotation policy doc.

Attachments uploaded to shared folder: AstraLith_SIG_v0.9.xlsx (client), Redwood_SOC2_Summary_Q1_2026.pdf (Redwood).
